[THE MAHARASHTRA SETTLEMENT OF ARREARS OF TAX, INTEREST, PENALTY OR
LATE FEE (PAYABLE BY PUBLIC SECTOR UNDERTAKING COMPANIES) ACT, 2025.]
[This Act received the assent of the Governor on the 21st March 2025; assent was first published in the
Maharashtra Government Gazette, Extraordinary No. 17, Part IV, on the 21st March, 2025.]

were levied, imposed or payable under various Acts implemented by the Department of
Goods and Services Tax, Government of Maharashtra and for matters
connected therewith or incidental thereto.
